That protection makes its rows structurally impossible to delete in place, as the out-of-band DELETE rejection above demonstrates. Residue 0 for this surface is therefore reachable only by DESTROYING the database, never by cleaning it. A packet claiming residue 0 here is claiming container teardown and should say so in those words.
